investigation_metadata.onboard_compression: PREDICTIVE LOSSLESS BAYER HUFFMAN ENCODING (INST_CMPRS_MODE=1, MMM_LUT0)

perspective_foreshortening_proof.conclusion: An unburied right circular cylinder at D~4m in Mastcam-100 (f=13458 px) has perspective limb convergence of only 0.08 to 0.35 deg for plausible tilt angles (20-75 deg), ruling out pure perspective foreshortening of parallel cylinder edges at >50 sigma. Convergence of 35.35 deg requires either physical tapering (cone/wedge) or oblique progressive burial in regolith.

contaminated_and_ambiguous_inventory.upper_right_pebble_description: Separate physical clast/pebble adjacent to the upper-right rim. Across the 36 front-arch radial stations (theta in [+150, -35] deg), ONLY ONE single far outlying point — at theta = -45.0 deg (x = 1083.34, y = 969.16, r = 22.40 px) — jumps outward across the shadow gap onto this pebble. The remaining 35 front-rim points (theta in [+150, -50] U [-40, -35] deg) and all 26 dorsal longitudinal stations lie cleanly on the target object.

exposed_rear_cap_arc_1to1_and_coaxial_ma.description: When the lower-left soil burial cut-off points (i=0..7, y=950.5..954.2) and dorsal generator transition points (i=32..35, x=1039.7..1041.1) are separated from the exposed rear end-cap arc (i=8..31, N=24 points from (1027.9, 949.9) to (1039.2, 945.9)), an exact 1:1 unscaled translation of the clean front-face ellipse fits the exposed rear cap to 0.172 px RMS (max residual 0.30 px). Allowing coaxial scale s to vary freely yields s = 0.968 (96.8% of front diameter, RMS = 0.1722 px), confirming zero statistically significant taper between the front and rear caps.

scale_ratio_analysis.conclusion: The scale ratio s = a_rear / a_front is mathematically underdetermined by the single exposed rear arc (95% CI [0.85, 1.15]). The data are fully consistent with a perfect cylinder (s = 1.000, Delta_RMS < 0.01 px).

1_ellipse_orientation_unidentifiability.verdict: Fully explained by observational noise (0.67 sigma, p = 0.50). The front rim has b/a = 0.83 over an incomplete 175° arc, making its orientation unidentifiable to within ±4.2°.

2_baseline_lever_arm_sensitivity.verdict: A transverse shift of the rear center by only 1.1 px rotates the center-to-center bearing by 1.6°. Over a 24-px single-side arc, centroid uncertainty alone explains the bearing difference.

3_camera_perspective_convergence.verdict: Central perspective convergence is only ~0.13°, an order of magnitude too small to explain the 3.3° spread alone.

4_physical_conical_taper.verdict: A slight 7.6% taper (s = 0.924) naturally tilts the dorsal silhouette edge by 1.57°, bringing the body axis (34.5°) and dorsal edge (33.0°) into geometric coupling.

5_joint_compromise_axis.verdict: A single strict cylinder axis at 31.06° satisfies all three features simultaneously with sub-pixel residuals (Front 0.24 px, Rear 0.31 px, Dorsal 0.35 px, Total 0.30 px).
